active_ingredient: Active ingredient Ethyl Alcohol, 70% v/v Purpose Antimicrobial
indications_and_usage: Uses hand sanitizer to help reduce bacteria on skin
warnings: Warnings For external use only. Flammble, keep away from fire or flame. Do not use in or near the eyes. In case of contact, rinse eyes thoroughly with water. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation, excessive redness or rash develops. Keep out of reach of children. Supervise children under 6 years of age when using this product to avoid swallowing. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.

dosage_and_administration: Directions Put a dime sized drop onto hands and rub together briskly until dry.
